disclosures.text: A roller for guiding and/or transport purposes
The roller is for conveyors and elevators
The roller comprises a support part
The roller comprises a bandage made of an elastomeric material
The bandage has at least one axially compliant side edge
A roller for guiding and/or transport purposes, comprising a support part and an elastomeric bandage, where the bandage has at least one axially compliant side edge
Annular grooves are introduced into the axial side edges of the bandage
The annular grooves' outer groove walls are aligned at an acute angle to the annular surface of the bandage
The annular grooves are interrupted by transverse walls
The bandage consists of an elastic polymeric material with a hardness greater than 90° Sh
The support part consists of a metal
The support part consists of plastic
The support part is designed as a metal-plastic composite part
